decisions.reason: The Black Edition range is close to the core offer, was publicly launched and promoted to its own page in 2024, and fits the firm's announced design-led bathroom direction, so management will keep it.
CeraFrame Liquid has had its own page for two consecutive years, was publicly launched, and is central to the firm's barrier-free, seamless bathroom strategy, which makes persistence very likely.

The pump-drain shower channel is newly launched with its own page and represents fresh investment that succeeds the withdrawn pump solution C, so any early weak results can still be attributed to the ramp-up and management will stay committed.
